gloss: to jot down; to take notes; to make a memo

definitions.gloss: to jot down; to take notes; to make a memo
definitions.explanation: To write down something briefly for future reference, typically a quick note rather than a detailed record.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}{番号|ばんごう}→電話番号：10159_denwabangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧メモした。
examples.english: I jotted down the phone number.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧メモしておいて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take notes on the contents of the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧なこと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧メモする⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: It's good to build a habit of jotting down important things right away.

notes:
From English "memo" + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. One of the most common loanword + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ combinations in everyday Japanese. Used casually for quick, informal note-taking — writing on sticky notes, typing into a phone, scribbling on paper. More casual than ⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧ or ⟦{書|か}き{留|と}める→書き留める：06730_kakitomeru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take notes (noun + ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ form is equally common)
- ⟦メモ{帳|ちょう}→メモ帳：11241_memochou⟧: memo pad; notepad
- ⟦メモ{用紙|ようし}→メモ用紙：29326_memoyoushi⟧: memo paper
- ⟦{付箋|ふせん}→付箋：08245_fusen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧メモする: to write a memo on a sticky note

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧: to record — more formal and thorough; implies an official or complete record
- ⟦{書|か}き{留|と}める→書き留める：06730_kakitomeru⟧: to write down; to note — slightly more formal than メモする
- ⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take notes — specifically in a notebook, often in lectures or classes
